TrTitle: Hostile review request schema and storage
FrBodyPreview: An authenticated agent can enqueue a bounded hostile review request scoped to the active workspace. The request includes target type, mode, scope statement, artifact links, request
TrBodyPreview: Persist ReviewRequest and QueueItem in EF with three-provider migrations. Reject serialized request JSON over 1048576 bytes before insert. Enforce workspace isolation on submit.

FrTitle: Artifact links resolve through MCP APIs
FrBodyPreview: Artifact links resolve only through supported MCP APIs (TODO, FR/TR/TEST, session log, triage, plans, files, commits, generated docs). Missing, unauthorized, stale, or ambiguous li
TrBodyPreview: Resolver calls supported MCP APIs only. Diagnostics are stored on the request. Successful resolve stores identity and hash when available.

FrTitle: Reviewer run records model effort identity
FrBodyPreview: Each reviewer execution records model, effort, agent identity, plugin/source, prompt template/version, run id, timestamps, and token/runtime metadata when available. Missing metada
TrBodyPreview: ReviewExecution entity stores model string, effort, agent, plugin/source, template id/version, run id, start/end UTC. Token counts are optional and must not be invented.

FrBodyPreview: Normalized findings distinguish defects, risks, missing tests, unclear requirements, insufficient disclosure, out-of-scope, and uncertainty. Verdicts are AGREE, DISAGREE, or UNKNOW
TrBodyPreview: Finding.category is an enum of the seven classes. Verdict is AGREE|DISAGREE|UNKNOWN. RequestQualityAssessment has five explicit numeric or ordinal fields.

FrBodyPreview: Query reports filter by workspace, model, effort, requesting agent, reviewer agent, target type, artifact type, severity, and category. Combined filters AND. Empty match is empty l
TrBodyPreview: Query API applies AND across provided dimensions and returns empty list on no match, not an error.

FrBodyPreview: Default behavior is queue-and-record. Completing a review does not edit product files, requirements, or TODOs. Surfaces expose submit/status/get/query only.
TrBodyPreview: No apply/repair endpoint is registered. REST, REPL, Director, and plugin skill expose the four verbs only and do not write product files from verdicts.

FrBodyPreview: A read-only workspace validation service uses a versioned rule registry and a shared result contract with rule code/version, severity, entity kind, workspace identity, record IDs,
TrBodyPreview: IWorkspaceValidationService returns a DTO with the required fields. Unknown rule codes emit diagnostics. Clean workspace returns zero findings.

FrBodyPreview: Rules identify FR/TR/TEST with no AC rows, TR with no FR, FR lacking TR/TEST, TEST with no FR, and broken or duplicate mappings.
TrBodyPreview: Each rule emits a finding with record id and evidence. TEST exclusion only if a documented rule says so.

FrBodyPreview: Rules identify done=true with incomplete tasks, done=false with all tasks complete, completion without doneSummary, remaining vs completion contradiction, missing dependency target
TrBodyPreview: Each mismatch emits a finding with the TODO id and evidence of the contradicting fields.
TestConditionPreview: Rule_DoneTrue_IncompleteTasks; Rule_DoneFalse_AllTasksComplete; Rule_DoneWithoutDoneSummary; Rule_RemainingContradictsCompletion; Rule_MissingDependencyTarget; Rule_MissingReferenc

TrTitle: Stale-turn clock and triage domain enum
FrBodyPreview: Turns in_progress more than 48h after authoritative timestamp (injectable UTC clock) are findings. Triage reports in live non-terminal states are findings. Override threshold is po
TrBodyPreview: IUtcClock is injectable. Threshold default 48h. Triage states come from the live domain model. Auth, cancellation, and pagination are enforced.

TrTitle: Hygiene surface adapters and Director exit codes
FrBodyPreview: REST, Director, REPL, and plugin skill expose the same validation. Same rule codes, identities, severities, counts, and threshold. Never auto-repair. Director exit 1 on Error or Cr
TrBodyPreview: Four surfaces call the same service. Director maps Error/Critical to exit 1 and Warning-only to exit 0. JSON always written. No repair methods.

FrBodyPreview: Optional --include-dump on wiki export emits versioned JSON dump of MCP tables keyed by source workspace, including TODO rows and requirement links. No-flag behavior is unchanged.
TrBodyPreview: schemaVersion mcp-wiki-dump/v1. SHA-256 per table plus root hash. Flag default off. tables[] uses McpDbContext DbSet names.

TrTitle: Import remap and dump parameter binding
FrBodyPreview: add-workspace --dump on WorkspaceClient.CreateAsync / POST /mcpserver/workspace hydrates TODOs from dump, remaps workspace identity, rejects malformed dumps with no partial write.
TrBodyPreview: Bind --dump to WorkspaceController.CreateAsync. Remap workspace id, paths, FKs. Idempotent re-import. Reject malformed dump, version mismatch, missing tables, unsafe path.

FrBodyPreview: todo.yaml is deprecated as TODO source of truth. When dump and todo.yaml both exist, dump wins and a diagnostic names both. Cleanup archives to .mcpServer/archive/todo-yaml/ with e
TrBodyPreview: Discovery classifies generated/shadow/deprecated. Archive is copy then optional remove with report. Conflict diagnostic includes both paths.
